column1: # HD sprites (port_hdsprites.c, khhd_sprites.py, the launcher's importer). Tab-separated:
# name  group(1 cards, 2 title, 3 battle HUD)  frame(- any)  tiles  box x0 y0 w h (GBA pixels, frame coordinates)  Re:CoM asset:texture  recipe  [regions: eu,us,jp; default all]
# Card illustrations: matched by eye (hdcards_gba.py sheets vs Re:CoM families); borders and digits: hdcards_parts.py.
# Map cards: Re:CoM's cr_### contain the 22 regular illustrations; Key to Rewards
# is in the remastered menu's UK_card image19, not a standalone CARD texture.
# Their borders use the dark shades/gold of com_card01 (GBA borders are darker).
# Corresponding story keys; the GBA's first key uses a question-mark drawing,
# while Re:CoM uses ck_001's key symbol. Inventory/door rules stay those of GBA.
# World images (22/10): the 13 worlds of the world select; Re:CoM's cl_### are the same pictures on an opaque blue
# glow. Group 4: the game cuts each to its cartridge sprite's silhouette when it loads it (port_hdsprites.c).
# HP ring (22/10, user's pick): Re:CoM's player gauge (pl_gauge); the game cuts the face's hole, makes the empty
# track and fills it with the HP (port_hdsprites.c, PortHdHpRing). Tiles '-': not a cartridge sprite.
# Reload card (22/10): com_card02's black card is the GBA's; its counter (1..19) with Cockpit.imz's bold digits (1.5's).
# Re:CoM 1.5's battle HUD as its own layouts draw it (22/10, user: look like the HD, play the same): the layouts as
# they are (raw: files of the .SPR container) and their whole textures; port_hdlayout.c draws them (HUD_HD_RECOM.md).
# Room synthesis requirements (generated by synthesis_requirement_hd.py --tsv): Re:CoM room01 pieces.
# End of the room synthesis requirements.
